issues.description: The solution's assembleBookstore function is declared to return Void but actually returns a Bookstore. The problem statement (and the commented template stub) specify assembleBookstore should create and return a Bookstore (signature -> Bookstore). This return-type mismatch will cause a compile error in the provided solution and confuses students about the expected signature.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the solution's assembleBookstore function signature to return Bookstore (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) so its declared return type matches the actual returned value, or alternatively remove the return and have the function build the bookstore via side effects if the intent was to return Void. Preferred fix: update signature to '-> Bookstore' and keep the existing return Bookstore(books: books) implementation.
